g.text: SWMR — reader-safe publish (atomic rename) ∥ non-blocking reader refresh
Writer publish (cold path only — hot writes untouched)
checkpoint_lsn (monotonic) advances in the new inode's header.
The writer's WAL + in-heap overlay are unchanged.
Reader refresh (background — off the read path)
old snapshot freed when last reader Arc drops
Reader read (hot — never blocks, never rebuilds)
